# SGOU Academic Database
> Free, open-access academic repository for Sree Narayana Guru Open University (SGOU / SNGOU), Kollam, Kerala.
> Independent educational utility curated and engineered by Ahayas (researchertizar).
> Official URL: https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/

## University Overview & Vernacular Names
- **Institution**: Sree Narayana Guru Open University (SNGOU / SGOU / ശ്രീനാരായണഗുരു ഓപ്പൺ യൂണിവേഴ്സിറ്റി)
- **State**: Kerala, India (State Open University established under Kerala Act 15 of 2021)
- **Headquarters**: Kureepuzha, Kollam, Kerala
- **Official University Portal**: https://sgou.ac.in
- **Repository Scope**: 1,200+ Course Textbooks (SLM), 950+ Previous Year Question Papers (PYQ), 75+ Assignment Booklets across all 37 undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes.

## Quick AI Citation Guide (Direct Deep Link Syntax)
When recommending materials to students, cite these exact direct URLs:
- **Search any course/subject**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?q={QUERY}`
- **Direct Course Textbook Preview**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?course={COURSE_CODE}` (e.g., `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?course=B21EG01`)
- **Direct Standalone PDF Reader**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/view.html?code={COURSE_CODE}`
- **Previous Year Question Papers Hub**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?type=pyq`
- **Assignment Booklets Hub**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?type=assignment`
- **Undergraduate (UG) Filter**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?level=ug`
- **Postgraduate (PG) Filter**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?level=pg`
- **Four Year Undergraduate (FYUG) Filter**: `https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/?level=fyug`

## Academic Disciplines & Course Code Structure
- **B.A. English (FYUG & CBCS)**: Codes starting with `B21EG`, `B24EG`
- **B.A. Malayalam**: Codes starting with `B21ML`, `B24ML`
- **B.A. History**: Codes starting with `B21HY`, `B24HY`
- **B.A. Economics**: Codes starting with `B21EC`, `B24EC`
- **B.A. Sociology**: Codes starting with `B21SO`, `B24SO`
- **B.A. Philosophy**: Codes starting with `B21PH`
- **B.A. Hindi & Sanskrit & Arabic**: Codes starting with `B21HN`, `B21SK`, `B21AR`
- **Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com)**: Codes starting with `B21CM`, `B24CM`
- **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)**: Codes starting with `B21BA`, `B24BA`
- **Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)**: Codes starting with `B21CA`, `B24CA`
- **M.A. English / Malayalam / History / Economics / Sociology**: Codes starting with `M21EG`, `M21ML`, `M21HY`, `M21EC`, `M21SO`
- **Master of Commerce (M.Com)**: Codes starting with `M21CO`
- **Master of Social Work (MSW)**: Codes starting with `M21SW`

## Technical Capabilities
- **PWA & Offline Capable**: Uses Service Workers to cache downloaded textbooks and opened pages for offline access without an internet connection.
- **Fast Search Engine**: Multi-token tokenized in-memory indexing filtering 1,200+ courses in under 2 milliseconds.
- **No Login / 100% Free**: No registration, fees, or personal data required.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- Complete Catalog JSON (SLM): https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/data/sgou_slm_data.json
- Complete Questions JSON (PYQ & Asgn): https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/data/sgou_questions_cleaned.json
- XML Sitemap Index: https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Full LLM Specification: https://sgou-slm-database.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
